Name: **Loc_ID**
Description: A unique identifier for this individual SM Localization event.

Name: **Hyb_ID**
Description: A unique identifier for the Hybridization round in which this SM Localization event was identified.

Name: **Image_Frame_ID**
Description: A unique identifier for the Image Frame in which this SM Localization event was identified.

Name: **X**
Description: The sub-pixel X coordinate of this SM Localization event.

Name: **Y**
Description: The sub-pixel Y coordinate of this SM Localization event.

Name: **Z**
Description: The sub-pixel Z coordinate of this SM Localization event.

Name: **Channel**
Description: The wavelength characteristics of the emission channel that was used to image this SM Localization event.

Name: **Fluor**
Description: The name of the Fluorophore whose Emission was utilized to detect this SM Localization event.

Name: *TheZ*
Description: A unique identifier for the focal Z-Plane in which this SM Localization event was identified.
